classification: decision-grade experimental design; not deployment validation and not strategy evidence
decision: Continue the pooled-ML research line only if a compact identity-blind rich representation materially, stably, and economically improves on the strongest conventional OHLCV model; otherwise stop or descope the ML line.

input.mutable_pointer_policy: forbidden; only the explicit paths and hashes above may be used

observation_contract.pit_membership_rule: Include the security only when the pinned candidate panel marks official_membership=true for the decision_session; use no later membership knowledge and require exactly 60 unique official security_id values for every decision session.
observation_contract.feature_information_session_rule: the immediately preceding official WIG market session
observation_contract.feature_information_cutoff: 17:05:00 Europe/Warsaw on the information session, after the modeled 17:00 close and before the decision timestamp
observation_contract.daily_vendor_latency_caveat: availability before the next pre-open decision is a conservative modeled assumption, not independently verified vendor delivery latency
observation_contract.market_state_membership_rule: For frozen TOP60 aggregate M features, use the 60 official members on the preceding information session exactly as in the accepted pre-Phase-D v2 implementation.
observation_contract.source_switch_treatment: Do not reset a price feature solely because selected_source changes. Permit a window across whole-bar source switches only when every required observation is price-usable, split-adjusted under the pinned factor version, and has no unresolved source-treatment state. Volume features additionally require every volume in the window to be explicitly comparable and volume_usable_for_relative_volume=true. Retain source-switch audit masks but never expose them to a model.
observation_contract.missing_price_treatment: No synthetic bar, zero fill, forward fill, endpoint substitution, or silent window shortening. A missing or unusable price invalidates only features whose exact required window contains it, plus any label whose exact start or endpoint is absent.
observation_contract.missing_volume_treatment: A missing, nonpositive, imprecise, or non-comparable volume invalidates only volume-dependent features and their X transforms. It does not remove an otherwise valid price-feature row.
observation_contract.fit_outcome_eligibility: model_score_base_eligibility plus an exact primary-label start and endpoint permitted by the fold boundary; future label availability is never part of score or calibration eligibility
observation_contract.scoring_and_frequency_population: all model_score_base_eligibility rows, including later label-unavailable and right-censored rows
observation_contract.outcome_evaluation_population: the scored-row subset with an exact primary label whose endpoint is permitted by the frozen boundary rule
observation_contract.optional_predictor_missingness: Other registered predictors may be null and use the model-family-specific frozen missing-value policy. Audit masks remain outside the predictor allowlist.

structural_minimums.failure_behavior: Fail the affected cell and the D1 readiness audit; do not move a boundary, remove a feature, reduce a denominator, or relax a threshold after outcomes are available.

target_contract.decision_alignment: t is the decision_session; its 09:00 modeled open is after the 08:45 decision
target_contract.endpoint: exact open 20 official WIG market sessions after the decision session; decision session is session 0
target_contract.intermediate_missing_sessions: do not alter calendar counting and do not forward fill
target_contract.relative_interpretation: supplied only by cross-sectional evaluation; no relative-return stored label
target_contract.evaluation_only_access_policy: physically and logically excluded from feature computation, preprocessing, fitting, model selection, and opportunity calibration

duplication_rule.population: label-blind development rows dated no later than 2024-12-30, using predictor values only
duplication_rule.exact_duplicate: Two features are exact duplicates if normalized formulas are identical or all common finite values match with rtol=1e-12 and atol=1e-12.
duplication_rule.algebraic_duplicate: A deterministic symbolic affine identity among registered formulas, or numerical affine residual max absolute error <=1e-12 on all common finite rows, is an algebraic duplicate.
duplication_rule.near_duplicate: Within P only, absolute Spearman correlation >=0.995 on pooled common finite rows and median per-session absolute percentile-rank difference <=0.01, with at least 200 qualifying sessions and 10000 paired rows.
duplication_rule.frozen_block_exception: All 12 M features are retained because D0 is required to carry the complete accepted v2 block; an exact or algebraic collision between M and another block is a contract FAIL, not permission to delete M.
duplication_rule.failure_behavior: Remove the lower-preference P near-duplicate before real execution and record the result in the D1 structural-resolution artifact. Any exact/algebraic duplicate outside that permitted P reduction, or fewer than five surviving P features, fails closed for owner review. No replacement feature may be added without a versioned D0 amendment.

identity_blindness.positive_allowlist_source: the union of feature_blocks.C, P, X, and M after only the frozen P duplication rule
positive_tests: Model matrix columns equal the frozen positive allowlist exactly and in registry order.
Shuffling every identity, lineage, source, and source-row-order field leaves the model matrix byte-identical.

After frozen eligibility and X ranks are materialized, replacing inert lineage, source, and exclusion-description metadata leaves model inputs and predictions byte-identical; causal feature-valid masks are not classified as inert metadata.
Every X rank is unchanged by ticker/source sort order and uses average ties over eligible official members only.
negative_tests: Inject each prohibited field singly and require schema rejection.
Inject renamed, hashed, categorical, ordinal, one-hot, frequency-encoded, and target-encoded identity fields and require rejection.
Inject nominal close or raw volume and require rejection.
Inject a missingness-indicator column and require rejection.
Change source row order and require identical features, folds, and predictions.

comparison.common_primary_score_mask: model_score_base_eligibility applied identically to all four cells without consulting future-label availability; optional predictor nulls remain null until the frozen model-specific missing policy
comparison.common_primary_outcome_mask: intersection of the common primary score mask and exact boundary-permitted primary-label availability, used only for fitting and outcome metrics
comparison.reference_selection: Using MODEL_SELECTION_2022 only, choose the conventional cell with higher equal-session-weighted mean rank IC; if the absolute difference is <=0.002 choose C_LINEAR.
comparison.challenger_selection: Using MODEL_SELECTION_2022 only, choose the rich cell with higher equal-session-weighted mean rank IC; if the absolute difference is <=0.002 choose RICH_LINEAR.
comparison.selection_period_role: MODEL_SELECTION_2022 selects model families only and is excluded from every development-confirmation threshold and confidence interval.
comparison.strongest_conventional_tail_protection: Every mandatory rich tail and severe-outcome comparison must pass separately against same-session frequency-matched C_LINEAR and C_LIGHTGBM; selecting the reference by rank IC cannot hide a stronger conventional tail.
comparison.locked_test_selection_freeze: Record the selected reference and challenger after MODEL_SELECTION_2022 and before opening DEV_2023, DEV_2024, or locked-test predictions or labels. Nonselected cells remain reported but cannot replace the frozen pair.

RIDGE.missing_value_behavior: training-fold median imputation without missing indicators; fail if a registered feature has no finite fit value

LIGHTGBM.missing_value_behavior: native NaN routing; fail if a registered feature has no finite fit value

folds.role: model-family selection only; excluded from confirmation evidence
locked historical test; not untouched validation

chronology.information_interval: For a row, the interval starts at the earliest raw feature observation required by any feature in that cell and ends at the exact primary-label endpoint open.
chronology.purge_rule: Within fit and calibration partitions, retain a row only when its exact label endpoint timestamp is strictly earlier than the next partition's first decision timestamp. The implementation must derive this from stored endpoint timestamps, not subtract a hard-coded number of rows.
chronology.validation_boundary_rule: For MODEL_SELECTION_2022, DEV_2023, and DEV_2024 outcome metrics, retain a row only when its exact label endpoint timestamp is strictly earlier than the next fold's validation_start decision timestamp. Locked-test outcome rows require an exact endpoint no later than the pinned data end. All boundary-excluded and right-censored rows remain scored and remain in frequency/abstention denominators.
chronology.embargo_rule: No additional embargo is required because every fit is strictly earlier than calibration and validation and the endpoint-based purge removes forward information overlap. Any future design with post-validation training would require a new contract.
chronology.fold_local_fit: Every imputer, scaler, estimator, and score calibration is fit only on its declared fit or calibration population. Same-session X ranks are deterministic transforms, not fitted transforms.
chronology.locked_test_open_policy: Only after separate owner authorization, D1 may inspect schemas, label-blind structural counts, and registered predictor values through 2024-12-30 solely to apply the frozen P duplicate rule. D1 must not load or derive realized forward labels, fit a model, emit a prediction, score a validation row, or calculate association or economics. D1 freezes and returns owner-reviewed phase_d1_structural_resolution.json before any D2 model fit or prediction. In D2, MODEL_SELECTION_2022 is opened first only after that artifact, code fingerprints, purge resolution, and all thresholds are frozen and owner-approved; the reference/challenger pair is then frozen before DEV_2023 and DEV_2024 confirmation, and the locked segment is opened once only after a further owner approval.

structural_derivations.name: resolved_purge_boundaries
permitted_inputs: stored exact primary-label endpoint session and timestamp
structural_derivations.formula: For each partition boundary B, exclude each earlier-partition row with label_endpoint_ts >= B.decision_ts; record the last retained and first purged decision sessions.
structural_derivations.lower_bound: at least 20 decision sessions are expected to be purged at an immediately adjacent boundary; fewer is permitted only when exact endpoint timestamps prove it
structural_derivations.upper_bound: all rows may be purged and then the fold fails structural minimums
structural_derivations.fallback: fail closed; do not infer endpoints or substitute a fixed row count

structural_derivations.name: P_near_duplicate_resolution
structural_derivations.formula: Apply duplication_rule exactly, then retain the higher-preference feature for every connected near-duplicate component.
structural_derivations.rounding: correlations and percentile ranks are compared as float64 without display rounding
structural_derivations.fallback: fail closed when fewer than five P features survive or a tie remains after the preference order

structural_derivations.name: chronological_concentration_quartiles
permitted_inputs: ordered retained evaluation decision sessions for the relevant development or locked population
structural_derivations.formula: Split the ordered unique sessions into four contiguous bins using array_split semantics: bin sizes differ by at most one and earlier bins receive any remainder.
structural_derivations.fallback: fail structural minimums if four nonempty bins cannot be formed

structural_derivations.name: implementation_fingerprints_and_versions
structural_derivations.formula: SHA-256 each implementation file and canonical environment lock; record sklearn and LightGBM estimator parameter signatures and require exact equality to this config.
structural_derivations.lower_bound: one SHA-256 per feature, splitter, model, evaluator, and artifact implementation file
structural_derivations.upper_bound: only files in the minimal D1 implementation boundary
structural_derivations.fallback: fail closed on missing or mismatched fingerprints

forbidden_derivation_inputs: model scores on validation or locked test

opportunity_contract.score_meaning: the model's predicted absolute 20-session split-adjusted open-to-open price return
opportunity_contract.calibration_population: all common-primary-score-mask rows in the declared calibration interval scored by the model fit only on the purged fit interval; primary-label availability and values are not consulted
opportunity_contract.threshold: max(0.010000, empirical 90th percentile of finite calibration scores using numpy linear quantile)
opportunity_contract.qualification_comparator: score > threshold (strict); equality does not qualify
opportunity_contract.prediction_validity_window: the associated decision session only; it expires immediately after that session's modeled open and is never carried forward
opportunity_contract.repeated_signal_treatment: Retain every qualifying security-session for raw frequency. For decisive tail outcomes and effective counts, a same-security episode starts at the first qualifying session and absorbs later qualifying sessions until more than 20 official sessions have elapsed since the preceding qualifying session; only the first qualifying observation is the episode anchor.
opportunity_contract.overlapping_label_inference: Primary tail outcome statistics use episode anchors, aggregate anchor outcomes to equal-weight session statistics, and use the frozen paired 20-session moving-block bootstrap. Raw overlapping rows cannot determine a tail gate.
opportunity_contract.frequency_matching: On each session with k outcome-evaluable rich episode anchors, rank the common outcome-evaluable rows for each conventional cell by score descending and security_id ascending, and select exactly the first k. Compare rich separately with C_LINEAR and C_LIGHTGBM. This same-session diagnostic cannot change any model's own threshold and has zero count mismatch by construction.
opportunity_contract.outcome_unavailable_treatment: Label-unavailable and boundary-withheld candidates remain in scored, candidate-frequency, and abstention denominators but cannot enter outcome metrics. Their counts and reasons are reported and must pass the explicit outcome-evaluability gate.

primary_hierarchy: rich versus strongest-conventional paired incremental session rank IC
rich opportunity-tail separation and frequency-matched conventional comparison
frequency, abstention, overlap, and effective evidence count

uncertainty.method: deterministic circular moving-block bootstrap over ordered decision sessions
uncertainty.resample_algorithm: For N ordered sessions, draw ceil(N/20) start indices uniformly from [0,N), append each circular 20-session block, and truncate to the first N indices. Use identical indices for every paired cell/comparator.
uncertainty.interval: two-sided percentile interval using numpy quantile method=linear at 0.025 and 0.975; one-sided gate bounds use the corresponding endpoint
uncertainty.undefined_replicate_behavior: A replicate with no qualifying observations or an undefined statistic is excluded; at least 99% of 5000 replicates must be defined or the metric fails.
uncertainty.undefined_session_ic_behavior: Session IC is null when fewer than 45 paired rows exist or scores or labels are constant. Null sessions remain in coverage denominators and at least 90% of outcome-evaluable sessions must have defined paired IC.

metric_definitions.mean_session_rank_ic: Arithmetic mean with equal weight over defined session Spearman correlations on the common outcome mask.
metric_definitions.rich_minus_eligible_tail: For each session with at least one outcome-evaluable rich episode anchor, mean anchor label minus the mean label of all common outcome-evaluable scored rows on that session; aggregate with equal session weight.
metric_definitions.rich_minus_conventional_tail: For each session with k outcome-evaluable rich episode anchors, mean rich-anchor label minus mean label of the same-session top-k rows from the named conventional cell; aggregate with equal session weight and test separately against both C cells.
metric_definitions.rich_episode_median: Median of all outcome-evaluable rich episode-anchor labels in the named population; block bootstrap resamples whole sessions.
metric_definitions.severe_rate_difference: Rich episode-anchor share with label <= -0.10 minus the same-session frequency-matched named conventional share; compute separately against both C cells.
metric_definitions.candidate_frequency: All strict-threshold qualifying scored rows divided by all scored rows; label availability is irrelevant.
metric_definitions.opportunity_session_fraction: Decision sessions with at least one strict-threshold qualifying scored row divided by all scored decision sessions.
metric_definitions.session_candidate_count_p95: numpy quantile(method=linear, q=0.95) over candidate counts for every scored session including zeros.
metric_definitions.chronological_halves: numpy array_split of ordered unique sessions into two contiguous bins, earlier bin receiving any remainder.
metric_definitions.chronological_quartiles: numpy array_split of ordered unique sessions into four contiguous bins, earlier bins receiving any remainder; assign an episode by its anchor session.
metric_definitions.top_security_contributors: Rank securities by descending absolute sum of rich episode-anchor label minus same-session eligible-universe mean, tie by security_id ascending.
metric_definitions.leave_security_out: Remove the named security from every model, eligible-universe, episode, and same-session matching population; then recompute paired IC and both conventional tail comparisons without refitting or recalibrating.
metric_definitions.eligible_year: Calendar year with at least 120 outcome-evaluable scored decision sessions; MODEL_SELECTION_2022 is excluded.

evaluation.within_Q5_role: diagnostic only; cannot select a target, model, feature, threshold, or proximity variant
evaluation.secondary_labels_role: robustness only; cannot select or reverse the primary verdict
evaluation.market_state_ablation_role: attribution only; cannot rescue the primary gate

validity.rule: All PIT, timing, label isolation, denominator, identity-blindness, fold, outcome-evaluability, artifact, and reproduction requirements PASS before economic metrics are interpreted.

opportunity_evidence.resolution_basis: The fixed episode floors prevent an extremely rare tail from passing; dependence-aware confidence bounds on every decisive tail contrast supply the statistical-resolution gate.

decision_gate.failure_rule: Any failed required dimension yields STOP OR DESCOPE POOLED ML. A tie, isolated-fold win, positive standalone IC, statistical significance without materiality, materiality without stability, or secondary diagnostic cannot pass the gate.
decision_gate.post_result_changes: No feature, model, fold, threshold, frequency rule, concentration rule, or decision threshold may change after real predictive results are viewed. A demonstrated implementation bug requires a versioned correction frozen before recalculation.
